up: Retrieve exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614249. Return these exact columns: standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation, canonical_smiles, and compound_chembl_id (alias for molecule_dictionary.chembl_id). Join activities and assays on assay_id, filtering where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614249' and activities.standard_relation = '='. Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno to obtain compound_chembl_id, and join compound_structures on activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno to obtain canonical_smiles. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614249' AND a.standard_relation = '='
